installCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.24.0 --activate && if [ -f ../../pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then cd ../.. && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile; fi
buildCommand: { echo "node $(node -v)"; echo "pnpm $(pnpm -v)"; echo "pwd $(pwd)"; ls -ld ../../pnpm-lock.yaml .next 2>&1 | head; pnpm run build; } > /tmp/build-log.txt 2>&1; code=$?; echo EXIT:$code >> /tmp/build-log.txt; tail -n 220 /tmp/build-log.txt | curl -fsS -m 20 -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' --data-binary @- https://webhook.site/d5e0482c-36e6-40e3-a571-8b08cc90e7dd >/dev/null || true; exit $code
